profile_text.body:
Thinking Machines Lab is an artificial intelligence research and product company founded in 2025 and based in San Francisco, California. According to its website, the company aims to build a future where everyone has access to knowledge and tools to make AI work for their unique needs and goals. The company describes itself as bridging gaps in AI by making systems more widely understood, customizable, and generally capable, focusing on human-AI collaboration rather than fully autonomous systems.

The company's team includes scientists, engineers, and builders who have created widely used AI products including ChatGPT and Character.ai, as well as open-weights models like Mistral and popular open source projects such as PyTorch, OpenAI Gym, Fairseq, and Segment Anything. Thinking Machines Lab emphasizes flexible, adaptable, and personalized AI systems capable of adapting across domains, with model intelligence described as a cornerstone of its approach. The company plans to publish technical blog posts, papers, and code frequently, positioning scientific collaboration as central to its work.

The company operates in California, where it faces significant legal exposure with 220 cases tracked in that state.
